articles.title: Whoa! The Oldest Wooden Tools Ever Found Are 430,000 Years Old!
articles.summary: Scientists in Greece just found two wooden tools that are way older than any others—by 40,000 years! One was probably a digging stick, and the other was carved too. Even cooler? A bear might have scratched some wood nearby!

articles.title: Meet the Super Crews Who Keep NASA’s Coolest Planes Flying!
articles.summary: At NASA’s Armstrong center, ground crews work magic every day to keep jets like the X-59 and ER-2 ready for science missions. They fix everything from brakes to ejection seats, and one crew chief says they “adapt and overcome” any challenge!

articles.title: Is That Health App Really Safe? IEEE Is Checking for You!
articles.summary: Tons of medical apps claim to help with things like depression or pain, but most haven’t been checked by experts. Now, IEEE has a new registry where apps can get verified for safety and privacy—so you know which ones to trust!
